slots.title: Check-In & Registration
slots.description: Speaker and attendee check-in and registration opens. Pick up your badge and get settled in!

slots.title: Opening Remarks
slots.description: Welcome to BSides South Jersey! Opening remarks and conference kickoff.

slots.title: How to Protect Your Enterprise Using the Presidential Protection Methodology
slots.speaker: Hazel Cerra
slots.description: KEYNOTE: Drawing on 25 years with the United States Secret Service — including protective detail for President Clinton — Hazel Cerra outlines how enterprise security teams can adopt the layered, intelligence-driven methodology used to protect the most high-value targets in the world.

slots.title: AI Governance – How Do You Balance Productivity and Risk with Shadow AI
slots.speaker: Alex Muentz
slots.description: A practical look at AI governance challenges organizations face when employees adopt AI tools outside of sanctioned channels — and how security teams can balance productivity gains against the risks of Shadow AI.

slots.title: Fully Automated Phishing: How Attackers Use Vibe Coding to Generate and Launch Campaigns in Minutes
slots.speaker: Yotam Perkal
slots.description: A deep dive into the emerging threat of AI-assisted phishing — how attackers are using vibe coding and LLM tooling to generate, personalize, and launch phishing campaigns at machine speed.

slots.title: Using LLMs to Compare Enterprise AI Security Strategies with MITRE ATLAS
slots.speaker: Thomas Heverin & Baldwin Students
slots.description: An academic-practitioner collaboration exploring how large language models can be used to analyze and compare enterprise AI security strategies against the MITRE ATLAS framework.

slots.title: Learning Out Loud: My Ongoing DF/IR Challenge
slots.speaker: Christopher Eng
slots.description: A candid talk about the ongoing journey of learning digital forensics and incident response — what works, what doesn't, and how to build skills in the field.

slots.title: Morning Break
We're Losing the War for Identity
slots.speaker: Rich Mozeleski
slots.description: A stark assessment of the identity security landscape — why attackers consistently win the war for identity, and what defenders need to do differently to turn the tide.

slots.title: We are building the Next-Generation Quantum-Enhanced Cybersecurity Tools You're going to be using!
slots.speaker: Brian Callahan
slots.description: An exploration of quantum-enhanced cybersecurity tooling in development — what's coming, what the hype is, and what practitioners actually need to know to prepare.

slots.title: AI Security 101: A Practical Roadmap from AppSec to LLM Threat Hunting
slots.speaker: Pavan Reddy
slots.description: From traditional application security to LLM threat hunting — a practical roadmap covering the evolving AI attack surface, threat models, and detection strategies for security practitioners.

slots.title: The Applied Science Approach to Corporate Defense for the Corporate National Security Mission
slots.speaker: Zachary Schmidt
slots.description: How applied science principles can transform corporate cybersecurity defense programs — bridging the gap between academic research and the national security mission of the enterprise.

slots.title: Lunch
Security Operation Fundamentals (SOC)
slots.speaker: Kay Prashad
slots.description: KEYNOTE: A ground-up look at Security Operations Center fundamentals — building effective detection pipelines, escalation workflows, and analyst skills that scale.

slots.title: The Secret Threats All Around Us
slots.speaker: Michael Meyer
slots.description: An eye-opening look at the hidden threats hiding in plain sight — physical, digital, and social vulnerabilities most organizations overlook until it's too late.

slots.title: Why Teachers Are the Best Hackers
slots.speaker: Jennifer Landon
slots.description: An exploration of the surprising parallels between teaching and hacking — and why the skills educators develop make them uniquely suited to think like adversaries.

slots.title: ATT&CK in the Cloud – Identifying MITRE ATT&CK Cloud Techniques in Intrusion Analysis
slots.speaker: Bill Batchelor
slots.description: A hands-on look at how MITRE ATT&CK cloud techniques manifest in real intrusion investigations — mapping attacker behavior to the framework to improve detection and response.

slots.title: An Experience and Journey in Incident Response
slots.speaker: Tapan Soni
slots.description: A practitioner's personal story navigating the world of incident response — lessons learned from the field, the tools that failed, the ones that worked, and what it takes to build a mature IR program.

slots.title: Digital Manhunts & Cyber Clues: My Journey Through Federal Digital Forensics
slots.speaker: Craig Porter
slots.description: A first-hand account of federal digital forensics investigations — the tools, techniques, and surprising challenges of tracking adversaries through digital evidence.

slots.title: When the Watchdog Bites: Reputational Denial of Service Attacks
slots.speaker: Al Crowley
slots.description: An exploration of Reputational Denial of Service attacks — how adversaries weaponize public perception, social media, and disinformation to damage organizations without ever touching their infrastructure.

slots.title: Afternoon Break
Panel Discussion
slots.description: A moderated panel featuring Brian Callahan, Kay Prashad, Craig Porter, and Bill Batchelor — an open discussion on the state of cybersecurity, lessons from the field, and what comes next.

slots.title: Closing Remarks & Awards
slots.description: Thank you for joining us at BSides South Jersey. Award presentations, closing remarks, and farewell.
